notes: No plain-language layer or claims file exists for this genome; drafted.* and claims.* were not graded.

The recheck reports 0 mismatch, 0 needs_review, 0 warn; its 77 unchecked sentences were checked by hand (probe, subgroup, ablate, concept, linearise, and a scratch recomputation of the hazard ratios, spreads and survival metrics).

The 'meaningful' grade of tumour_biology rests on the concept tool's rule (score 0.905 >= 0.8 from AUC 0.953 of a sign-level threshold); R2 is 0.30 and the text says the concept carries the direction, not the value.
The three leaves are the explainer's grouping of five independent additive edges (no hidden node); any grouping would preserve the function.
The hormonal-therapy term is consistently called an association; no text claims a treatment effect.
Nothing was written to the database or to the target; scratch files are under the verifier's scratch directory.
